protocol.workload: quote/trade replay of data/native/bench/events_100x.jsonl (1,241,800 events) with policy/examples/taker_1s.json
protocol.p90_rule: conservative nearest-rank p90 of the 12 timed runs (11th of 12); the prior 3-run evidence used the slowest run for n=3
protocol.retention: all 28 attempts (2 warmups + 12 timed per profile) retained in evidence/labd/T25_B2_B3_PROFILE_runs.jsonl; per-run receipts and logs retained locally under evidence/labd/T25_*.json and evidence/labd/T25_B2_B3_PROFILE.log

B2.note: The conservative nearest-rank p90 misses the 30 s target by 141 ms (0.47%) under RP-4G and 351 ms (1.17%) under RP-8G. Using elapsed_ms instead of wall still misses under RP-8G (30.188 s) and equals 30.000 s under RP-4G. Prior non-profile evidence measured 20.545 s, which is not reproducible on the current host.

atomicity.sub_line_budget_parity: chunk-bytes=1 completed all 12418 records and matched the materialized tape

exploratory_attempts.note: Earlier sets were retained to show host variance and are not used for the final p90. They include failed and passing attempts.

single_scope_5run.note: single cgroup scope with warm page cache; no improvement, so the miss is not a per-scope cold-cache artifact

acceptance_note: B3 passes with a 4x margin. B2 misses its 30 s warm p90 by 0.14-0.35 s on the current host. The miss is filed rather than hidden; #13 cannot claim full acceptance on B2. The prior 20.545 s B2 figure remains historical evidence and is not reproduced by the profile re-run.
